study_site.name: Eight Mile Lake Permafrost Observatory, Healy, Alaska
study_site.program_context: NASA Arctic-Boreal Vulnerability Experiment (ABoVE) & Schuur Lab Flux/Borehole Supersite

provenance.primary_observable: Geocoded Polarimetric Covariance (GCOV) L-band terrain-corrected backscatter (HH, HV)
provenance.secondary_observable: Geocoded Unwrapped Interferogram (GUNW) 12-day repeat-pass phase browse (2026-09-02 to 2026-09-14)
provenance.access_tier: Official NASA/ASF Earthdata Cloud georeferenced browse rasters + CMR UMM-G metadata
provenance.radiometric_scaling_note: Full 7.5 GB Level-2 HDF5 granules require authenticated Earthdata Login tokens. Pixel grids in this prototype map the official georeferenced GCOV LATLON/NATIVE browse channels across documented terrestrial L-band gamma0 display bounds (HH: -24 to -2 dB; HV: -31 to -9 dB). Backscatter intensity changes reflect surface dielectric (freeze/thaw, soil moisture, snow wetness) and vegetation roughness—NOT direct underground ice imaging or certified vertical subsidence.
provenance.license: NASA Open Data Policy — public domain scientific observations (cite NASA/ISRO NISAR & ASF DAAC)

gunw.caution: Line-of-sight phase includes late-summer soil moisture dielectric phase and atmospheric delay; never equate directly with vertical thaw settlement without multi-pair coherence validation.

quality_legend.3: Wet snow / zero-curtain dielectric confounder caution
